name: devhub
description: DevHub core, Vite dashboard and desktop shell.

scripts.desktop:dev: node apps/desktop/scripts/stage-all.mjs && cargo tauri dev --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && npm run lint -w apps/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @devhub/shared-actions && npm run typecheck -w ai-notes-server && npm run typecheck -w apps/ui
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/ui && npm run test:node
scripts.test:all: npm run test:all -w apps/ui && npm run desktop:test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs packages/mcp/bin/devhub-mcp.test.mjs
scripts.test:node: node --test scripts/workspace-paths.test.mjs scripts/checkout-rebuild.test.mjs scripts/checkout-payload-smoke.test.mjs scripts/paseo-service.test.mjs packages/mcp/bin/devhub-mcp.test.mjs apps/desktop/scripts/boot.test.mjs apps/desktop/scripts/is-entry.test.mjs apps/desktop/scripts/managed-tools.test.mjs apps/desktop/scripts/native-binaries.test.mjs apps/desktop/scripts/payload-npm.test.mjs apps/desktop/scripts/stage-resources.test.mjs apps/desktop/sidecar/supervisor.test.mjs apps/desktop/sidecar/supervisor-runtime.test.mjs
